name: Oatmilk Everyday Draft Latte
caffeineNote: 120 mg per La Colombe's product page (shown as a marketing badge; caffeine is not listed on the nutrition panel). Not yet label-verified.
summary: The dairy-free version of the Everyday Draft Latte, built on oatmilk instead of lactose-free whole milk and sold in the same 9 oz nitrous-charged can. A long-running SKU rather than a new launch; we have not yet checked a can against its label.
